Adaptive intent segmentation has a close recent match: [S2-CAR (2026)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25415) models intent as a continuous latent energy state and uses a context-aware soft temporal point process to identify boundaries through energy decay, avoiding fixed time-gap rules. It then aggregates coherent segments into multiple interest representations; the authors report that segmentation also improves existing recommendation backbones. [ScaleRec (2026)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ipm.2025.104318) offers a complementary approach: multi-scale Transformers, dual attention for transient versus stable interests, and adaptive masking to reduce redundant interactions. [MIMAR-SRec (2026)](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/38489) combines contextual windows with intent prototypes and contrastive learning, supporting multiple intent horizons rather than a single recent-interest representation. These papers motivate adaptive context selection, but do not establish gains on the pinned RecHarness evaluation.

A directly relevant gating precedent, although older, is [TLSRec (2022)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.04760): hierarchical local/global attention plus an aspect-level neural gate conditioned on elapsed time since the last interaction. At prediction, use only timestamps already observable in the history; do not condition on the withheld next interaction’s timestamp. For larger catalogs, [Scalable Cross-Entropy, 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.18721) approximates full CE using GPU-efficient maximum-inner-product selection of informative candidates, reporting substantial memory savings. Sampling distribution matters: a [2024 empirical study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17276) finds dataset-dependent accuracy and popularity tradeoffs across random, popularity, mixed, and adaptive samplers. Thus, harder or more popular negatives should not be assumed universally better.

First use uniform negatives excluding known training interactions and the current target; this prevents observed collisions but cannot eliminate unobserved false negatives.
